name: 8.2-kiloyear event
short_desc: A sharp cooling episode disrupts Holocene climate, especially around the North Atlantic.
date_note: About 8,200 years BP, with BP fixed at 1950, plotted at roughly 6250 BCE after rounding. This locates the episode, not an exact onset or duration; estimates vary from roughly 150 years for its central Greenland signal to several centuries for broader changes.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.
